summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end frontend testing of TrustPause 2.0 Iteration 2 with visual overhaul. All new features (glassmorphism styling, glowing Protection: ACTIVE badge, gradient SVG gauge, renamed scenario labels, new linear countdown bar in SMS modal, updated CTA text, compacted header layout) verified successfully. All regression tests passed including the critical press-and-hold interaction with real mouse events. Zero console errors, excellent visual design, fully responsive.
passed_tests: App loads with zero console errors at https://firewall-shield-hub.preview.emergentagent.com
NEW: Glassmorphism styling (.tp-glass, .tp-glass-strong) applied to header, tabs, cards, overlays
NEW: Glowing 'Protection: ACTIVE' badge with emerald glow effect (.tp-glow-emerald) visible in header
NEW: Gradient+glow SVG risk gauge with animated values working correctly
NEW: Scenario labels renamed correctly: 'SMS Phishing', 'UPI Payment Lock', 'Digital Arrest Call', 'Deepfake Audio'
NEW: Linear countdown-bar (data-testid=countdown-bar) present in SMS intervention modal with aria-valuenow progressing from ~0 to 100 over 10 seconds
NEW: SMS safe CTA text changed to 'Open Official Bank App' (verified in intervention-safe-cta)
NEW: Header layout compacted to single row at 1920px width with status-chip (xl+) and status-chip-mobile (below xl)
Header elements: title 'TrustPause 2.0', subtitle 'The Ambient Human Firewall', protection badge, risk gauge, view toggle, mute toggle, reset button all present and functional
SMS Phishing: Link click triggers intervention modal with BOTH circular countdown (starts at 10, counts down to 0) AND new linear progress bar (0% to 100%)
SMS Phishing: Countdown bar aria-valuenow increases correctly from 6% to 100% over 10 seconds
SMS Phishing: 'Open anyway' button correctly DISABLED during countdown and ENABLED after countdown completes
SMS Phishing: 'Open Official Bank App' CTA closes modal, shows safe outcome (sms-outcome-safe), risk drops to 8
SMS Phishing: Report button shows reported outcome (sms-outcome-reported), risk drops to 6
SMS Phishing: Override after countdown shows overridden outcome (sms-outcome-overridden), risk rises to 91-92
UPI Payment Lock: Amount ₹18,000 and payee rahul.kmr9284@okaxis displayed correctly
UPI Payment Lock: Pay Now triggers Action Lock overlay (action-lock-overlay), risk rises to 88
UPI Payment Lock: Press & hold for 1.5s then release correctly resets progress to 0% (tested with real mouse.down/up, NOT click)
UPI Payment Lock: Hold progress increases correctly (32% at 1s, 64% at 2s, 99% at 3s)
UPI Payment Lock: Press & hold for 3+ seconds completes override, shows overridden outcome (upi-outcome-overridden), risk rises to 96
UPI Payment Lock: Call Saved Contact shows verify outcome (upi-outcome-verify), risk drops to 14
UPI Payment Lock: Cancel Payment shows cancelled outcome (upi-outcome-cancelled), risk drops to 6
Digital Arrest Call: Start call shows incoming call card (incoming-call-card) with caller name 'CBI Cyber Crime Branch'
Digital Arrest Call: Call risk card (call-risk-card) appears after ~1s with unverified VoIP and secrecy markers
Digital Arrest Call: Answer call shows transcript (call-transcript) progressively, risk rises to 95
Digital Arrest Call: End Call & Report shows ended outcome (call-outcome-ended), risk drops to 5
Digital Arrest Call: Verify Helpline shows verified outcome (call-outcome-verified), risk drops to 12
Deepfake Audio: Waveform (data-testid=waveform) present with data-playing=true when playing
Deepfake Audio: Risk factors reveal progressively - urgency +15, fear +20, secrecy +20, synthetic +30 (all data-detected=true)
Deepfake Audio: Cognitive risk total (cognitive-risk-total) correctly shows exactly 85/100
Deepfake Audio: Intervention banner (deepfake-intervention-banner) appears when risk >= 70
Deepfake Audio: Verify Code Word shows verified outcome (deepfake-outcome-verified), risk drops to 12
Deepfake Audio: Block & Report shows blocked outcome (deepfake-outcome-blocked), risk drops to 8
View toggle: Phone mode (view-toggle-phone) wraps scenario in phone frame, all interactions work inside frame
View toggle: Desktop mode (view-toggle-desktop) returns to dashboard stage
Architecture drawer: Toggle (architecture-drawer-toggle) expands/collapses drawer correctly
Architecture drawer: Shows all 4 cards (call-screening, accessibility, link-handling, ios-hooks)
Architecture drawer: Privacy callout (privacy-callout) present with 'no 24/7 background screen recording' text
Telemetry panel: Signal count (signal-count) resets to 0 after reset, populates to 4 after SMS link click
Telemetry panel: Event timeline (event-timeline) logs events during interventions
Reset simulation: Clears event timeline, resets signal count to 0, resets risk to baseline, restores scenario to initial state
Mute cues toggle: Toggles aria-pressed state correctly, app runs without errors with cues muted
Responsiveness (1920x1080): No horizontal overflow, header in single compact row, all elements visible
Responsiveness (1024x768): No horizontal overflow, header controls wrap appropriately, tabs tappable
Responsiveness (390x844): No horizontal overflow, title visible, status-chip-mobile visible, modal readable and scrollable
Visual design: Glassmorphism styling visibly applied with blurred translucent cards
Visual design: Emerald glow on protection badge and active tab clearly visible
Visual design: LED animation (.tp-led) on status indicators working
Visual design: No contrast issues - all text readable on glassmorphism backgrounds
Visual design: No horizontal scrollbar at any tested width (1920, 1024, 390px)
Stability: Repeated scenario runs work correctly, no stuck timers, no duplicate overlays, zero console errors
